newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 12.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 12.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Romanian Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea started his two-day visit to Hungary and will have comprehensive talks with Prime Minister Gyula Horn in the afternoon.
- Farmers' protests continued in most counties, but roadblocks were set up in less places and by a smaller umber of protestors.
- The World Bank has granted Hungary an $225 million loan framework agreement for the modernisation of the cuntry's banking sector and industry.
- Agriculture MInister Frigyes Nagy has reaffirmed that the government is ready to attend round table talks about Hungary's farming policy.
- Minister of Interior Gabor Kuncze said there is no prospect to change municipalities' legal framework before the 1998 elections.
